archetypes.name: dyn-cache-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Ledger keying and resume semantics are central to avoiding stale verdict reuse.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the analyze_bugs ledger load, ingest, queue selection, and report join paths. Focus on whether cache keys include issue number, fix SHA, and later history hash, and whether stale or corrupt ledger rows are safely ignored. Check deep cap and sample provenance handling against the workflow intent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
